hero.label: Careers & Opportunities
hero.headline: Your Next Role Starts Here.
hero.subtext: Access top opportunities with leading US and India enterprises. Whether you're a seasoned consultant or exploring new horizons — we'll find the right fit.

items.title: Access to Top Employers
items.description: Direct relationships with enterprise clients across the US and India — roles that aren't posted publicly.

items.title: Dedicated Recruiter Support
items.description: A dedicated recruiter who understands your skills, goals, and career trajectory — not just your resume.

items.title: Fast Placement Process
items.description: From submission to offer in days, not weeks. We move at the speed of opportunity.

items.title: Compliance & Benefits
items.description: Full legal compliance, competitive pay rates, and benefits support for all engagement types.
Short to long-term contract roles with top US enterprises.
Start on contract with a clear path to permanent employment.
Direct hire placements for full-time career opportunities.
Opportunities for independent consultants and small firms.

submitResume.headline: Submit Your Resume
submitResume.subtext: Send us your resume and a brief note about the type of roles you're targeting. Our team will reach out within 24–48 hours.

consultantMarketing.headline: Already on the Bench?
consultantMarketing.subtext: If you're an available consultant looking for your next engagement, our bench sales team actively markets your profile to our network of vendors and direct clients.
